42. Load Balancing and Health Checks

A load balancer distributes traffic across healthy backend instances; health checks help avoid
routing to unavailable instances.

Q: Is a health check the same as load balancing?
A: No. Health checks inform eligibility; a balancing algorithm selects a backend.
